subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in not more than
guide_solution: Summary Our National Memorial is the symbol of our deepest respect for the martyrs of our Liberation War. It has actually 7 towers that rise by stages to the height of 150 feet. Its foundation was laid on the first victory day in 1972. There are also a mosque, a library and a museum in the complex of the memorial. The Memorial reminds us that nothing but strong will and determination is needed to gain freedom.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Nawab Faijunnesa Govt. Girls' High School, Comilla. Sl. No. 28; Page No. 77
